item.title: Belgium’s Top Court Clears Diamond Dealer Mehul Choksi’s Extradition to India in ₹13,000-Crore Bank Fraud Case
item.description: GUWAHATI: Belgium’s top judicial authority has dismissed fugitive businessman Mehul Choksi’s attempt to block his extradition to India, rejecting his claims that he would face torture, inhuman treatment and degrading prison conditions if sent back. The ruling effectively removes the last legal barrier to Choksi’s extradition in connection with the ₹13,000-crore Punjab National Bank (PNB) fraud case. item.title: Veteran Sculptor Ram Sutar Passes Away at 101
item.description: GUWAHATI: Renowned Indian sculptor Ram Sutar passed away at the age of 101, marking the end of an era in Indian art and sculpture. A towering figure in the field, Sutar was recently honoured with the prestigious Maharashtra Bhushan Award by the Maharashtra government for his lifetime contribution to art.
